item.title: Logo design
item.dc:creator: Cluxia
item.description: I’m currently working on making a project of mine, Cluxia, a bit more public. At the moment it consists only of public chat services (XMPP) but it will eventually provide free email, social network, git hosting etc. What I would want is a logo that we can use for the project, possibly alongside a color palette and font. The logo would be used on the website, but also as an avatar for the project on various services.
item.content:encoded:
Organization: Cluxia

Status: filled

Compensation: gratis

Role: Logo design & branding

I’m currently working on making a project of mine, Cluxia, a bit more public. At the moment it consists only of public chat services (XMPP) but it will eventually provide free email, social network, git hosting etc.

What I would want is a logo that we can use for the project, possibly alongside a color palette and font. The logo would be used on the website, but also as an avatar for the project on various services.

“Cluxia” is originally the combination of “clusia” (a tree, somewhat neutral?) with the “x” of XMPP. A current draft of what I want to publish on cluxia.eu is linked alongside this post and may help to get a picture of our target.

How to Apply:

  • Maxime “pep” Buquet <pep@bouah.net>
  • https://cluxia.eu https://cluxia.eu/draft

item.title: Help designing a distinguishable, clean, and modern looking logo and color scheme.
item.dc:creator: Mailchain
item.description: Brief Mailchain enables blockchain-based email-like messaging with plain or rich text and attachment capabilities. Using blockchain protocols and decentralized storage, Mailchain delivers a simple, secure, messaging experience. We’re looking for a new logo and color scheme to be used across the Mailchain website and application (Open Source). It should also take the Mailchain tenets into account and be simple, clean and modern. Existing logos can be seen on the Mailchain website (https://mailchain.xyz) (light and dark), and twitter.
item.content:encoded:
Organization: Mailchain

Status: closed

Compensation: gratis

Role: Logo design, branding & color scheme

Brief

Mailchain enables blockchain-based email-like messaging with plain or rich text and attachment capabilities. Using blockchain protocols and decentralized storage, Mailchain delivers a simple, secure, messaging experience.

We’re looking for a new logo and color scheme to be used across the Mailchain website and application (Open Source).

It should also take the Mailchain tenets into account and be simple, clean and modern.

Existing logos can be seen on the Mailchain website (https://mailchain.xyz) (light and dark), and twitter.

Colors can be similar to what we have today, or something quite different, but should help make it easy to read and interact with the user interface. The current inbox theme uses barebones bootstrap theme colors. You can see a video walkthrough of the existing interface here.

How to Apply:

  • Tim <team@mailchain.xyz>
  • https://github.com/mailchain/mailchain-web/issues/80 https://github.com/mailchain/mailchain-web/issues/81

Read more on opensourcedesign.net →
